{{Top|leg}}
The '''Brentaal League of Guilds''' was a league on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. On 38:4:21 [[Great ReSynchronization|GrS]], the League declared a [[Landmark Holiday]], celebrating the fact that more stocks and [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] were exchanged during the prior five-day period than at any time in history.
